propositions.name: conscious_order_not_arbitrary
propositions.quote: The order in which we arrange conscious phenomena does not admit of any arbitrariness. It is imposed upon us and of it we can change nothing.
propositions.statement: The order in which we arrange conscious phenomena is imposed upon us and does not admit of any arbitrariness.

propositions.name: no_direct_duration_equality_intuition
propositions.quote: We have not a direct intuition of the equality of two intervals of time
propositions.statement: We have not a direct intuition of the equality of two intervals of time.

propositions.name: same_causes_take_same_time
propositions.quote: It is that the duration of two identical phenomena is the same; or, if you prefer, that the same causes take the same time to produce the same effects.
propositions.statement: The duration of two identical phenomena is the same, so the same causes take the same time to produce the same effects.

propositions.name: pendulum_beats_equal_by_definition
propositions.quote: To measure time they use the pendulum and they suppose by definition that all the beats of this pendulum are of equal duration.
propositions.statement: All the beats of the pendulum are supposed by definition to be of equal duration.

propositions.name: tides_slow_earth_rotation
propositions.quote: Many of them think that the tides act as a check on our globe, and that the rotation of the earth is becoming slower and slower.
propositions.statement: The tides act as a check on the earth so that the rotation of the earth is becoming slower and slower.

propositions.name: time_defined_for_law_simplicity
propositions.quote: So that the definition implicitly adopted by the astronomers may be summed up thus: Time should be so defined that the equations of mechanics may be as simple as possible.
propositions.statement: Time should be so defined that the equations of mechanics may be as simple as possible.

propositions.name: light_velocity_constant_all_directions
propositions.quote: He has begun by supposing that light has a constant velocity, and in particular that its velocity is the same in all directions.
propositions.statement: Light has a constant velocity and its velocity is the same in all directions.

propositions.name: cause_defines_temporal_anteriority
propositions.quote: Behold then the rule we follow, and the only one we can follow: when a phenomenon appears to us as the cause of another, we regard it as anterior.
propositions.statement: When a phenomenon appears as the cause of another we regard it as anterior.

propositions.name: thunder_sound_after_electric_discharge
propositions.quote: We hear the sound of the thunder only some seconds after the electric discharge of the cloud.
propositions.statement: We hear the sound of the thunder only some seconds after the electric discharge of the cloud.

propositions.name: light_propagation_not_instantaneous
propositions.quote: That is not altogether true, since the propagation of light is not instantaneous; if absolute exactitude were desired, there would be a correction to make according to a complicated rule.
propositions.statement: The propagation of light is not instantaneous.

propositions.name: positions_velocities_determine_evolution
propositions.quote: The positions and the velocities of three bodies at a given instant suffice to determine their positions and velocities at the following instant, and consequently at any instant.
propositions.statement: The positions and the velocities of three bodies at a given instant suffice to determine their positions and velocities at any instant.

propositions.name: rules_chosen_because_most_convenient
propositions.quote: We therefore choose these rules, not because they are true, but because they are the most convenient
propositions.statement: The rules for simultaneity and duration are chosen not because they are true but because they are the most convenient.

propositions.name: experiment_could_contradict_postulate
propositions.quote: Is it impossible that experiment may some day contradict our postulate?
propositions.statement: Experiment may some day contradict the postulate that the same causes take the same time.

propositions.name: star_light_takes_time_to_reach_earth
propositions.quote: at least two hundred years were necessary for the light from that star to reach our earth
propositions.statement: At least two hundred years were necessary for the light from that star to reach our earth.

propositions.name: eclipse_perceived_simultaneously_over_earth
propositions.quote: Or else they observe an astronomic phenomenon, such as an eclipse of the moon, and they suppose that this phenomenon is perceived simultaneously from all points of the earth.
propositions.statement: The astronomers suppose that an eclipse of the moon is perceived simultaneously from all points of the earth.

propositions.name: telegraph_reception_after_sending
propositions.quote: It is clear first that the reception of the signal at Berlin, for instance, is after the sending of this same signal from Paris.
propositions.statement: The reception of the signal at Berlin is after the sending of this same signal from Paris.

propositions.name: newton_law_experimental_truth
propositions.quote: Newton’s law is an experimental truth; as such it is only approximate
propositions.statement: Newton’s law is an experimental truth and as such is only approximate.

propositions.name: transmission_duration_practically_neglected
propositions.quote: In general, the duration of the transmission is neglected and the two events are regarded as simultaneous.
propositions.statement: In general the duration of the transmission of a signal is neglected and the two events are regarded as simultaneous.

propositions.name: stellar_event_has_definite_epoch
propositions.quote: When an astronomer tells me that some stellar phenomenon, which his telescope reveals to him at this moment, happened, nevertheless, fifty years ago, I seek his meaning
propositions.statement: A stellar phenomenon which the telescope reveals at this moment happened a definite time before, such as fifty years ago.
